companyFieldUpdates.description: Mexico Telecom Partners, legally Mexico Tower Partners, S.A.P.I. de C.V., is a neutral Mexican digital-infrastructure platform that owns and operates towers, rooftop sites, distributed antenna systems, small cells, edge facilities and data-center infrastructure. The platform serves major wireless operators and colocation users across Mexico. It was formed in May 2014 by combining Digital Bridge and Macquarie Mexican Infrastructure Fund portfolios. A June 2026 BMV filing reported approximately 3,737 sites and confirmed an unchanged 50/50 ownership split: DigitalBridge through MTP Mexico Holding B.V., and Macquarie Asset Management through MMIT I and MMIT II. The 2022 Macquarie-side transfer was internal, InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and no signed or closed direct platform sale was identified through August 19, 2026.

set.event: The 50/50 Digital Bridge and Macquarie Mexican Infrastructure Fund combination closed to form Mexico Tower Partners; the transaction was announced the following day.
Macquarie transferred its MTP shares and related loans internally to MMIT I and MMIT II without changing Macquarie's aggregate 50% interest.
